Description: Core conversational capabilities of the Contoso Care customer-service agent built in Copilot Studio.
Authored topics that resolve the most common customer requests without a human.

Title 3: Check order status by order number
Description: As a returning customer, I want to check my order status by giving my order number, so that I know when my delivery arrives without calling support.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Valid order
Given an order number that exists
When I enter it in the chat
Then the agent shows status, carrier and expected delivery date

Scenario: Unknown order
Given an order number that does not exist
When I enter it
Then the agent says it can't find the order and asks me to re-check the number

Scenario: Wrong format
Given text that is not a 10-digit order number
When I enter it
Then the agent explains the expected format and lets me retry

Description: As a registered customer, I want to start a password reset from the chat, so that I can regain access without waiting for an agent.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Known email
Given an email linked to an account
When I ask to reset my password and give that email
Then a reset link is sent and the agent confirms without revealing account details

Scenario: Unknown email
Given an email with no account
When I give it
Then the agent shows the same neutral confirmation message

Scenario: Rate limit
Given 3 reset requests in 15 minutes
When I request a 4th
Then the agent tells me to wait 15 minutes

Description: As a customer with an unshipped order, I want to change my delivery address in the chat, so that my package goes to the right place.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Unshipped order
Given an order not yet shipped
When I provide a new valid address
Then the address is updated and I get a confirmation

Scenario: Already shipped
Given an order already shipped
When I ask to change the address
Then the agent explains it can't be changed and offers carrier redirect options

Scenario: Invalid address
Given an address that fails validation
When I submit it
Then the agent asks me to correct the highlighted fields

Description: Grounded answers from Contoso's approved knowledge content.

Title 3: Answer return-policy questions from the policy site
Description: As a customer considering a return, I want clear answers about the return policy, so that I know whether my item qualifies before I start a return.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Policy covered
Given a question covered by the return policy page
When I ask it
Then the agent answers and cites the policy page link

Scenario: Not covered
Given a question not covered by any knowledge source
When I ask it
Then the agent says it doesn't know and offers to connect me with support

Scenario: Out-of-date page
Given the policy page is updated
When I ask the same question after the next index refresh
Then the answer reflects the new content

Title 3: Show cited source with every generative answer
Description: As a support manager, I want every generative answer to show its source link, so that customers and auditors can verify where answers come from.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Answer with source
Given a generative answer is produced
When it is displayed
Then at least one source link is shown under the answer

Scenario: No source found
Given no source meets the confidence threshold
When the agent would answer
Then it falls back to the 'I don't know' message instead

Title 3: Build the whole knowledge base integration
Description: Integrate all of Contoso's knowledge into the agent: SharePoint sites, the public website, product manuals (PDF), the FAQ database, and the internal wiki. Include search, permissions, refresh schedules and analytics.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: All sources
Given all knowledge sources are connected
When a customer asks anything
Then the agent answers correctly

Description:
When the Contoso Care agent can't resolve a request, it must hand the conversation to a human agent in Dynamics 365 Customer Service (Omnichannel) without the customer repeating themselves.

Triggers: customer asks for a human; agent fails to understand twice in a row; negative sentiment detected; topics flagged 'always escalate' (billing disputes, legal complaints).

Context passed to the human agent: full transcript, customer identity (if authenticated), detected intent, order number if captured, and a 2–3 sentence AI summary.

Customer experience: customer is told they're being transferred and shown an estimated wait time; outside business hours (Mon–Fri 8am–6pm CT) the agent offers a callback or case creation instead.

Constraints: handoff must complete in under 10 seconds; if no human agents are available within 5 minutes, offer case creation; all handoffs logged for analytics.

Out of scope: voice channel, routing to external BPO partners.
Connect the Contoso Care agent to Dynamics 365 and Microsoft Teams.
Create and look up Dynamics 365 Customer Service cases from the agent.

Title 3: Create a support case from the conversation
Description: As a customer with an unresolved issue, I want the agent to open a support case for me, so that my issue is tracked and someone follows up.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Authenticated customer
Given a signed-in customer with an unresolved issue
When they agree to open a case
Then a Dynamics 365 case is created with title, description, transcript and contact linked, and the case number is shown

Scenario: Anonymous customer
Given a customer who is not signed in
When they ask to open a case
Then the agent collects name and email, matches or creates a contact, then creates the case

Scenario: Dataverse unavailable
Given the Dataverse connection fails
When the agent tries to create the case
Then it apologizes, retries once, then offers email support

Scenario: Duplicate
Given an open case on the same order in the last 24 hours
When the customer asks for a new case
Then the agent offers to update the existing case instead

Description: As a signed-in customer, I want to see my open cases and their status, so that I don't have to call to check progress.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Has cases
Given a customer with open cases
When they ask for their cases
Then the agent lists case number, title, status and last update

Scenario: No cases
Given a customer with no open cases
When they ask
Then the agent says there are none and offers to open one

Title 3: Add a note to an existing case
Description: As a customer with an open case, I want to add information to my case from the chat, so that the support team has the latest details.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Valid case
Given an open case owned by the customer
When they send extra details
Then a note is added to the case timeline

Scenario: Not owner
Given a case that belongs to someone else
When the customer references it
Then the agent refuses and asks for a case they own

Description: Make the agent available to internal staff in Microsoft Teams.

Title 3: Publish the agent to Microsoft Teams
Description: As a Contoso store employee, I want to chat with Contoso Care inside Teams, so that I can answer customer questions on the shop floor.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Installed
Given the agent is published to the Teams channel
When an employee opens it in Teams
Then they can start a conversation

Scenario: No license
Given an employee without access
When they try to install it
Then Teams shows the app is unavailable

Description: As a Contoso employee in Teams, I want to be signed in automatically, so that I don't have to log in again to see order data.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: SSO works
Given an employee signed into Teams
When they ask about an order
Then the agent uses their identity without a login prompt

Scenario: Consent missing
Given admin consent has not been granted
When the employee starts a chat
Then the agent shows a sign-in card

Description: Measure and govern the Contoso Care agent.
Dashboards that show how well the agent resolves requests.
As a customer-service manager, I want a dashboard of resolution, escalation and abandon rates by week, so that I can see whether the agent is reducing call volume.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Data present
Given at least one week of conversations
When I open the dashboard
Then I see resolution, escalation and abandon rates per week

Scenario: Filter
Given the dashboard is open
When I filter by topic
Then the rates recalculate for that topic only

Scenario: No data
Given a new environment with no conversations
When I open the dashboard
Then an empty-state message is shown

Description: As a compliance analyst, I want to export conversation transcripts for a date range, so that I can respond to audit requests.
As a conversation designer, I want a weekly list of the questions the agent didn't understand, so that I know which new topics to build next.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Weekly list
Given unrecognized utterances in the last 7 days
When I open the report
Then I see the top 20 grouped by similarity with counts

Scenario: Privacy
Given an utterance contains an email or phone number
When it appears in the report
Then the personal data is masked

Description: Control who can change the agent and what it may say.
As a agent owner, I want publishing to production to require a second approver, so that no untested change reaches customers.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Approval given
Given a maker submits a publish
When a second approver approves
Then the agent is published

Scenario: Rejected
Given a maker submits a publish
When the approver rejects with a reason
Then nothing is published and the maker sees the reason

Title 3: Block restricted topics in generative answers
Description: As a compliance officer, I want the agent to refuse questions about legal advice and competitor pricing, so that Contoso avoids regulatory and reputational risk.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Restricted asked
Given a customer asks for legal advice
When the agent processes it
Then it declines politely and offers to open a case

Scenario: Normal question
Given a question outside restricted topics
When the agent processes it
Then it answers normally

Description: As a IT administrator, I want a log of who changed topics, knowledge or settings and when, so that I can trace issues back to a change.
Acceptance Criteria:
Scenario: Change made
Given a maker edits a topic
When the change is saved
Then the log records user, item, change type and timestamp

Scenario: Retention
Given log entries older than 365 days
When the nightly job runs
Then those entries are archived
